## Body

**Performance: pass-with-notes** at `165c32215126ed72e5eb8949431f090cde50d559`.

Scoped repair review since the prior performance verdict at `464e06127edccf4356085c6e19075f52e292eef9`, not a fresh review of inherited #137. The previous cost qualifications remain except the empty-scope request read, which this repair removes. No new daemon executable launch site, independent timer, or per-seat launch loop.

| Repair | Cost and evidence |
|---|---|
| `--doc` scheduling | `harness/scripts/shared-build.sh:370-394` selects one nice-only cargo invocation, without generating a separate `--no-run` compile invocation. Doctests still compile during that run. Unlike a normal split test, this needs no extra cargo/nice invocation, inter-stage `df`, or compile-argument process substitution. Cost is per explicit caller, zero at rest. |
| EXIT drain | `shared-build.sh:219-239` reuses the existing process-group drain before releasing the lock; it launches no replacement cargo. Group checks and TERM/KILL are shell builtins; the existing drain can launch `/bin/sleep` up to ten times per second while a group survives, escalating after 100 ticks and continuing until the group disappears. This is shutdown-only, per active caller, not a hard ten-second bound. Clearing `child` in the signal handler avoids a second EXIT drain. |
| Digest scope | `pa_watchdog.rs:1068-1131` propagates failed PA/parent/prime reads, logs queue unavailability, and returns before reading requests. Successful empty scope skips all request-row queries in `store/src/role_requests.rs:280-289`; the preceding schema check still reads. Nonempty scope retains S + P + 1 data reads, S = 1-3 scope reads, P = selected projects, plus schema checks. Delivering metadata remains globally read and filtered, so its cost still scales with all delivering rows. This runs on digest attempts, with no new timer. |
| Final head | `165c322` adds the failed-prime-lookup regression and updates its evidence reference only. The repair's scheduling, drain, and production digest/store code are unchanged after `4ec4746`. |

**CI proof:** GitHub reports this exact head CLEAN. [CI 42229916587](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42229916587) has all four jobs successful; both Node 22 and 24 ran shared-build **18/18**, including doc-only scheduling and SIGUSR1 descendant cleanup. Rust JUnit records **2,037 executed cases, zero failures/errors**, including failed-holdings and failed-prime guards, digest scope, scoped/empty store results, and all six spawn guards. Five Rust tests were skipped separately. The exact-head delivers run **42229916594** also succeeded.

Scheduling tests use fake cargo/taskpolicy and real niceness. They do not measure macOS QoS inheritance; omitting a taskpolicy prefix is not a reset of inherited background QoS. The empty-store test proves returned results, while source control flow establishes the request-query bypass. No local builds, tests, runtime probes, or review-worktree mutations were performed.
